'''rebel router I Caught You''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[rebel router]]
* '''Published:''' 3 June 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber|CC-D-cloudcitycarbonitechamber.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat Cloud City Carbonite Chamber route.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Uses bounty hunters to capture opponents then carbon freezing to destroy or freeze opponents characters.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Start with Cloud City: Carbon Freezing Chamber as the starting location and use Twi'lek Advisor to deploy a carbon freezing.  Play bounty hunters to capture opponents and then escort them either to prison or to the carbon chamber to be frozen.  Use Darth Vader and Darth Maul to provide a little extra power.  Use ships to overpower the opponent and cause some decent battle loss to them while the ground troops take care of the rest.
